race.comment: SHE'S LOADED (9) resumes. She was racing well last time in and got home well in a recent Donald jumpout. John Allen can be positive from the inside gate and this looks a suitable race first up. MYSTERIOUS MASTER (6) resumes from a short break. He was just fair at Echuca when last seen back in May but was in the market there for the new yard and can improve quickly. SOMERS GREEN (12) is a filly by Brazen Beau on debut for the Matt Laurie yard who has jumped out well on a few occasions. She draws nicely and should be ready to go. CHALLENGING (2) is a gelding by All Too Hard on debut for the Maher yard who represents strong connections. Jumpouts have been fair and worth watching the betting. JINKIES (11) is a Blue Point filly for the Moloney yard who can run well.
